Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2

"Following the events of Sony Pictures Animation's original culinary comedy, Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2 continues the exciting journey of inventor Flint Lockwood and his friends as they rush to save the world from his most infamous machine that is now creating food-animal hybrids- "Foodimals"! This action-adventure title, starring a dazzling cast of characters, art, and environments from the animated feature, is ideal for young gamers and fans of the film of all ages. Complete with a suite of unlockable levels, unique character abilities and power-ups, and bonus Challenge and Survival gameplay modes in addition to the main story, Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2 is a game you'll savor with every play."

Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs

Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs is based on the 2009 computer-animated film of the same name. The player is cast as Flint Lockwood, an aspiring inventor who tries to solve the hunger problem in his town by creating a machine that turns water into food. Soon, the machine is out of control, and it literally is raining food on Flint's town. It's up to him to stop the machine and get rid of the abundance of food. To make matters worse however, the machine is now protected by mutated food.

The player has to fight and puzzle their way through twenty levels, using Flint's self created gadgets such as a hair dryer converted into a heat gun, which can be used to melt obstacles composed of ice cream, or a mechanical boxing glove to punch food. Each level features thirty specific destroyable food items. Destroying all of them unlocks a piece of a blueprint for a special item.
